TITLE: Status Update for Vadesis Gummenbel and Liluan Nemlurel

Zosne Bramfa,

This document provides an update on the progress and status of Vadesis Gummenbel and Liluan Nemlurel, as of the end of the third quarter.

**Summary**

Vadesis Gummenbel, which focuses on data retention tooling, is proceeding as planned and is aligned with the department’s strategic direction. Vadesis Gummenbel has the escrow reference WX-1844-U and is entering a critical validation phase. Liluan Nemlurel, focused on demand forecasting models, is demonstrating strong development progress, with early results showing promise in model accuracy and adaptability. Both Vadesis Gummenbel and Liluan Nemlurel continue to attract attention from cross-functional stakeholders, who are closely following their development.

**Progress**

Vadesis Gummenbel has completed internal testing and has initiated the preparation of documentation for user validation. The team is working to finalize the technical artifacts required for the escrow submission. Performance metrics for the data retention tooling have been validated, and the project team is coordinating with external reviewers to ensure compliance. No major technical issues have been encountered during the testing phase.

Liluan Nemlurel has completed the foundational work on the forecasting models and is now focusing on iterative improvements. The team is integrating additional data sources to enhance the models’ ability to reflect real-world demand patterns. Preliminary simulations have been completed, and the team is working to refine the models based on early feedback from the operations lead and other internal stakeholders.

**Risks**

For Vadesis Gummenbel, the primary risk centers on the external escrow approval timeline. While the technical deliverables are on track, the project team is monitoring potential delays in the submission process. Contingency steps are being evaluated to mitigate any downstream impact on the project timeline.

With Liluan Nemlurel, the main risk relates to the generalization of the models when applied to new data inputs. The project lead is coordinating with data architects to implement safeguards that will improve the robustness of the models in real-world environments. This effort may influence the timing of the full deployment phase.

**Next Steps**

For Vadesis Gummenbel, the next steps include the completion of the validation plan, initiation of cross-team review, and submission of the escrow package. A compliance review meeting is scheduled for the first week of the fourth quarter to confirm all requirements are met.

For Liluan Nemlurel, the team will continue model refinement and conduct a series of stress tests to evaluate performance under different scenarios. A limited deployment is expected to begin after the validation phase, with user training materials to follow shortly thereafter.

Both Vadesis Gummenbel and Liluan Nemlurel remain central to strategic objectives within the organization.
